utterances.speaker: JUDGE JORDA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Please be seated. Mr. Registrar, please be sure the accused is brought in, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE JORDA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So we shall resume our witnesses hearing. I'm saying that to the public, although there is none at the moment. We are about to hear some more Defence witnesses which will come and testify within the framework of a sentencing hearing of Mr. Jelisic, who has pleaded guilty of crimes against humanity and violations of customs of war. Mr. Nice, I see you're on your feet.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: I think two or three things I wanted to raise. First, in your order of the 5th of November, the Defence were ordered to disclose the identities and personal details of all the witnesses in question. It may be preferable for this small passage to be in private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE JORDA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Fine. Let's do so. Let us go into private session. I think that's much better. In fact, let us have a small Status Conference, if you will.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We are now in private session.
